chronology.label: THE SECRETARY'S MEETING WITH ROMANO PRODI, ITALIAN PRIME MINISTER, FEBRUARY 16, 1997, ROME, ITALY
chronology.note: Albright and Prodi discuss NATO enlargement, Italian support for Slovenia and Romania, Russia’s position, AFSOUTH, and the need for a balance between northern and southern Europe. Compiler use: Establish the Italian case before the Madrid decision, then compare Prodi’s June conversation with Clinton; cross-reference XVII. chronology.label: SECRETARY'S MEETING WITH KLAUS KINKEL, GERMAN FOREIGN MINISTER FEBRUARY 17, 1997, BONN, GERMANY
chronology.note: Albright and Kinkel discuss reaching agreement with Russia before enlargement, NATO and EU prospects for Baltic states, likely first entrants, and Bosnia refugee pressures. Compiler use: Compare German preferences with Italian and U.S. positions immediately before Moscow negotiations; distinguish NATO accession from EU accession. Date: Physical p. 1 states February 17, 1997; February 20 is transmission.

chronology.label: SECRETARYWS MEETING WITH HANS VAN MIERLO, DUTCH FOREIGN MINISTER, MAY 28, 1997, THE HAGUE
chronology.note: Albright presses accelerated Dayton implementation, police capacity, open cities, independent media and war-crimes accountability; Van Mierlo worries about renewed fighting and they discuss the High Representative succession. Compiler use: Trace U.S.–Dutch coordination of civilian implementation and SFOR policy as a 1997 Europe lead, separate from XV’s core 1993–95 chronology. chronology.label: SECRETARY'S MEETING WITH JAIME GAMA, PORTUGUESE FOREIGN MINISTER, MAY 29, 1997, SINTRA, PORTUGAL
chronology.note: Albright and Gama assess the NATO–Ukraine Charter, enlargement standards and an open door, Portuguese participation in European monetary integration and NATO partnerships. Compiler use: Add Portugal’s substantive position to the Madrid preparatory sequence and connect EU and NATO agendas; cross-reference XVII. Date: Physical p. 1 dates the contact May 29, 1997; June 4 is reporting metadata.

chronology.label: MEMORANDUM OF CONVERSATION BETWEEN THE PRESIDENT AND ITALIAN PRIME MINISTER PRODI ON JUNE 20,1997.
chronology.note: Clinton and Prodi discuss Dayton implementation and Albania, then disagree over the first NATO enlargement group. Prodi argues for Romania and Slovenia and describes limits to EU integration after Amsterdam; Clinton explains ratification constraints and an open-door signal. Compiler use: A direct presidential record connecting Italian regional priorities, the Madrid choice and the Amsterdam outcome. Pair with the February Albright–Prodi meeting and XVII’s enlargement file. Date: The body on physical p. 2 dates the meeting June 20, 1997, in Denver; July 9 is cable transmission.

chronology.label: SECRETARY'S MEETING WITH LUXEMBOURG EU PRESIDENCY FOREIGN MINISTER JACQUES POOS AND EUROPEAN COMMISSIONER SIR LEON BRITTAN, JULY 7, 1997, MADRID
chronology.note: Albright, Luxembourg foreign minister Poos and Commissioner Brittan discuss the New Transatlantic Agenda, summit deliverables, mutual recognition agreements and disagreements over Iran-related sanctions. chronology.label: SECRETARY ALBRIGHT'S MEETING WITH FRENCH FOREIGN MINISTER VEDRINE, DECEMBER 16, BRUSSELS, BELGIUM
